  "memo_markdown": "Merchant 56 breaches AUP-06.1: five disputes on 49 approved orders (10.2%); the probability of this count at the 2.5% policy rate is 0.0084. Bust-out remains a hypothesis: volume_z is negative and ticket size is near baseline, providing no corroborating sales ramp. A campaign alone would not dismiss valid disputes. Offboarding requires corroborated bust-out evidence."
